thread:
Maya Chen: Quick RFC draft — propose a compact "catalog artifact" we can attach to each onboarded model: JSON metadata + tiny benchmark and migration hints. Kicking off a 2-week "catalog hygiene" spike. Thoughts?
Lucas Park: Love the idea. Can you specify what fields ops will need? :gear: 
Maya Chen: Minimal fields: model_id, tested_hardware, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, quantization_profile, memory_bytes, compat_shim_required, allow_customer_pin, pin_ttl_days, migration_risk (0-5), golden_prompt_pass_rate, sample_golden_prompts (list), customer_migration_playbook_url.
Priya Nair: Add a numeric `migration_risk` + short rationale string. That helps CS prioritize outreach and decide migration credits.
Ethan Rivera: For pinning, propose `allow_customer_pin: boolean` and `pin_ttl_days: integer`. Defaults: true and 90. Enterprise contracts can set `allow_customer_pin=false` or custom TTL.
Lucas Park: Ops asks we include `tested_gpu: string` and `peak_memory_bytes`. Also add `canary_traffic_pct` and `canary_regions` to help schedule canaries.
DevopsBot: FYI: canary pipeline is at 18 queued jobs, ETA ~8h if we run full-region canaries.
Maya Chen: Given that, suggestion: `default_canary_pct: 25` and staggered rollout across regions to avoid queuing. We'll encode scheduling guidance in the runbook.
Priya Nair: Deprecation windows: I'd like a 3-stage flow: Announcement window, assisted migration window, final forced swap. I suggest 60/45/15 = 120 days. Tie shorter windows to low `migration_risk`.
Lucas Park: Make that paramized. e.g., if migration_risk <=1 then total_window_days=90 with breakdown 45/30/15.
Ethan Rivera: Also include `compat_shim_required: boolean` so runtime can load the shim automatically. If true, include `shim_version` and `shim_notes`.
Maya Chen: Good catch. I'm going to sketch a tiny example artifact here for clarity:

```
{
  "model_id": "open-llama-7b-v2",
  "tested_gpu": "A10G",
  "p95_latency_ms": "82",
  "tokens_per_sec": "450",
  "quantization_profile": "4bit-q4",
  "peak_memory_bytes": "68000000000",
  "compat_shim_required": "false",
  "allow_customer_pin": "true",
  "pin_ttl_days": "90",
  "migration_risk": "2",
  "golden_prompt_pass_rate": "0.9",
  "customer_migration_playbook_url": "https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/1234",
  "default_canary_pct": "25",
  "canary_regions": "[us-west1, eu-west1]"
}
```

Lucas Park: Nice. Tiny nit: make numeric fields real numbers not strings. But for the artifact file format we discussed machine-parsable strings are fine if the schema types are explicit.
Priya Nair: Action items: Maya to open short RFC + PR with schema draft; Lucas to add ops constraints (canary queues, gpu types, memory); Ethan to define default pin policy + exception flow; CS to draft migration comm templates based on `migration_risk` bands.
Maya Chen: Timeline: RFC PR by Thursday EOD, 30m sync Friday to finalize, then implement artifact ingestion in console next sprint. I'll post the PR and ping #product when ready.
CS-Bot: Created ticket RED-3421 for migration comm templates.
Ethan Rivera: One more ask: add `compat_shim_workaround: string` to capture runtime flags needed for degraded behavior. Helps on-call triage.
Maya Chen: Will add that field. Thanks all — I'll share the RFC link here when ready. :sparkles:
